Trichomes with several rays are stellate (exact synonym of PATO:0002065). 'Several' is too vague for a count, as in the earlier rejection of 'several'. (19 statements in 1 floras; confidence medium; batch 0162)

Allium bulb coats are described as fibrous or not. 'Without fibers' negates FLOPO:0991026 fibrous; these fibres are not PO fiber cells. (17 statements in 1 floras; confidence medium; batch 0163)

A stem branched like a panicle has a panicle-like architecture. FLOPO:0991198 already lists branch among its bearers. '2 ×' is a count of branching orders and goes to the count pattern. (17 statements in 1 floras; confidence medium; batch 0163)
Oviform = egg-shaped. PATO_0001891 ovate has egg-shaped and ovoid as synonyms; for bulbs and fruits it is the 3-D reading. (17 statements in 1 floras; confidence high; batch 0163)
'Thyrses panicle-shaped' means the architecture resembles a panicle: FLOPO:0991198. (17 statements in 1 floras; confidence high; batch 0163)

'Scales unsegmented or 2-segmented' means not divided into segments. It negates PATO_0002312 segmented. (15 statements in 1 floras; confidence high; batch 0163)

Veins that fork into two repeatedly. This follows the dichotomous rule (C199) to PATO bifurcated; the repetition does not need its own term. (13 statements in 1 floras; confidence medium; batch 0164)
Rhizome scales of one colour throughout, as opposed to bicolorous or clathrate scales, which is FLOPO concolorous. (13 statements in 1 floras; confidence medium; batch 0164)
